overview.purpose_zh: 每个品牌一条线，两端各一个圆点，分别代表 2024 和 2026 的份额；连线的长度就是这两年变化的大小。
works_zh: 比较同一个对象的前后两个值

understanding.read_zh: 每一行是一个品牌，左边的点是 2024 年，右边的点是 2026 年。先看连线的方向：往右是份额上升，往左是下降；再看连线有多长，越长变化越大；两个点几乎重合，就是基本没变。

elements.note_zh: 2024 年的份额，每行的左端点。
2026 年的份额，每行的右端点。
连线的长度就是变化量，方向说明涨还是跌。
左边一列是品牌名，每行对应一个品牌。

look_for_zh: 线的方向，往左还是往右
两个点几乎重合的品牌

observations.en: Nova has the widest gap: its share moved 9 points, from 18 to 27.
observations.zh: Nova 的连线最长：份额移动了 9 个百分点，从 18% 到 27%。

observations.en: Aurora's connector is the second longest, running from 31 down to 24, a gap of 7 points.
observations.zh: Aurora 的连线长度排第二，从 31% 降到 24%，差距为 7 个百分点。

observations.en: Kestrel is almost flat, moving just 1 point from 14 to 15.
observations.zh: Kestrel 几乎是一条平线，只从 14% 移动到 15%，变化 1 个百分点。

observations.en: Lumen, Orbit and Vertex each shifted by 1 point, all slightly down.
observations.zh: Lumen、Orbit 和 Vertex 各移动了 1 个百分点，都是小幅下降。

observations.en: The six brands still add up to 100 percent in both years.
observations.zh: 六个品牌在两年里的份额合计仍然是 100%。

describe.en: Kestrel stayed almost flat at around 15 percent between 2024 and 2026.
describe.zh: Kestrel 在 2024 到 2026 年间基本持平，维持在 15% 左右。
alternatives: Kestrel's share barely moved, from 14 to 15 percent.
Kestrel stayed flat for the two years, ending at 15 percent.
describe.note_zh: stay flat 允许小数点级别的移动，不要求完全一样；完全没动才用 remain constant。

describe.en: Kestrel rose slightly, from 14 to 15 percent.
describe.zh: Kestrel 小幅上升，从 14% 到 15%。
alternatives: Kestrel was slightly higher in 2026, at 15 percent.
There was a slight increase in Kestrel's share.
describe.note_zh: slightly 是幅度最小的一档，适合一个百分点的变化。

describe.en: Kestrel edged up from 14 to 15 percent, while Lumen, Orbit and Vertex each edged down by 1.
describe.zh: Kestrel 从 14% 小幅升到 15%，而 Lumen、Orbit 和 Vertex 各小幅下降了 1 个百分点。
describe.pattern: edge up + to / by + small amount
alternatives: Kestrel edged up 1 point to 15 percent.
Kestrel moved up slightly, from 14 to 15.
describe.note_zh: edge up 专门表示只涨一点点；涨幅大时不能用，换 climb 或 jump。

describe.en: Kestrel was on a par with Vertex at 15 percent in 2026.
describe.zh: 2026 年，Kestrel 和 Vertex 持平，都是 15%。
describe.pattern: A + be + on a par with + B
alternatives: Kestrel and Vertex were level at 15 percent in 2026.
Kestrel finished on a par with Vertex, at 15 percent each.
describe.note_zh: on a par with 表示水平接近或相等，比 the same as 留有余地；两者都是 15% 时最自然。

describe.en: Nova's share was 9 percentage points higher in 2026 than in 2024.
describe.zh: Nova 的份额 2026 年比 2024 年高 9 个百分点。
describe.pattern: X is + number + percentage points higher / lower than Y
alternatives: Nova gained 9 percentage points between the two years.
Aurora's share was 7 percentage points lower in 2026.
describe.note_zh: 哑铃图的连线长度就是百分点差，说差距时不要写成 percent。

describe.en: In 2024, brand shares ranged between 9 and 31 percent.
describe.zh: 2024 年，各品牌份额在 9% 到 31% 之间。
alternatives: The 2024 shares sat between 9 and 31 percent.
Brand shares covered a range from 9 to 31 percent in 2024.
describe.note_zh: 说区间用 between ... and ...，不要把 and 换成 to；from ... to ... 更强调起点和终点。

academic.en: The dumbbell chart depicts the market shares of six headphone brands at two points, 2024 and 2026, with each horizontal connector joining the two observed values. Nova shows the longest connector, advancing from 18 to 27 percent, a gain of 9 percentage points. Aurora moved in the opposite direction, from 31 down to 24, a decline of 7 points. Kestrel changed only slightly, from 14 to 15. Lumen, Orbit and Vertex each fell by 1 point, closing at 11, 8 and 15 percent. The six shares are recorded as summing to 100 percent in both years.
academic.zh: 这组哑铃图展示六个耳机品牌在 2024 年和 2026 年两个时间点的市场份额，每条水平线连接两个观测值。Nova 的连线最长，从 18% 升到 27%，增加 9 个百分点。Aurora 方向相反，从 31% 降到 24%，减少 7 个百分点。Kestrel 变化很小，从 14% 到 15%。Lumen、Orbit 和 Vertex 各减少 1 个百分点，分别收在 11%、8% 和 15%。六个品牌的市场份额在两年中都合计为 100%。

business.en: The pattern is straightforward for our market. Nova is the only brand with a big gain, up 9 points to 27 percent, and Aurora is the only one with a big loss, down 7 to 24. Every other brand stayed within a point of its 2024 share. Kestrel ended at 15 percent, Lumen at 11, Orbit at 8, and Vertex at 15. We are looking at a two-brand race with a long, stable tail. We should defend Nova's new lead, and we need a plan for Aurora to win back its lost share.
business.zh: 对我们所在的市场来说，这个格局很直观。Nova 是唯一大幅增长的品牌，上升 9 个百分点到 27%；Aurora 是唯一大幅下滑的品牌，下降 7 个百分点到 24%。其他品牌与各自 2024 年的份额相差都不超过 1 个百分点。Kestrel 收在 15%，Lumen 为 11%，Orbit 为 8%，Vertex 为 15%。我们看到的是两个品牌的竞争，加上一条长期稳定的尾部。我们应守住 Nova 新取得的优势，同时为 Aurora 制定夺回份额的计划。

simple.en: Nova went from 18 to 27 percent. That is the biggest jump. Aurora went from 31 to 24. That is the biggest drop. Kestrel went from 14 to 15, so it barely changed. Lumen, Orbit and Vertex each lost 1 point. They ended at 11, 8 and 15. All six brands still add up to 100 percent in both years.
simple.zh: Nova 从 18% 升到 27%，涨幅最大。Aurora 从 31% 降到 24%，跌幅最大。Kestrel 从 14% 到 15%，几乎没变。Lumen、Orbit 和 Vertex 各少了 1 个百分点，最后分别是 11%、8% 和 15%。六个品牌在两年里加起来仍然是 100%。

language_notes.body_zh: 哑铃图里两个圆点是数值，中间的连线才是变化。先说线有多长，再说方向：向右是上升，向左是下降。
examples: Nova's connector runs 9 points to the right.
Aurora's connector runs 7 points to the left.

language_notes.body_zh: 小幅变化常配 almost、just、only，语气比直接报数字更自然。almost flat 是几乎没动，just 1 point 是只有 1 个百分点，only 强调比预期小。
examples: Kestrel is almost flat, moving from 14 to 15 percent.
Lumen moved just 1 point, from 12 to 11.

language_notes.body_zh: 哑铃图两端都标注了值，适合用 from ... to ... 把两个端点都说出来；只说变化量时用 by。Nova from 18 to 27 是两个端点，moved by 9 是差值。
